brief:
Poverty and unemployment have worsened across Gaza as the war has crippled income sources and halted economic activity, Shehab Wire reported. Living conditions have deteriorated sharply, with destitution spreading across the territory as Palestinian families struggle daily to meet basic needs.

The collapse of economic activity has transformed securing food, water, and shelter into a constant challenge for households throughout the enclave.

title: War collapses Gaza's economy, deepens poverty and joblessness
